defensiveAbilities.name: Dig In
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The palpares is aboveground and would take damage

Effect The palpares Burrows up to its Speed, throwing up a shield of dirt that reduces the damage by 11.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breaching Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The palpares is underground

Effect The palpares Burrows up to twice its Speed underneath a creature, then Strikes upward with its pincers, ending aboveground.

offensiveAbilities.name: Palpares Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 3d6 Poison Damage damage and Stunned 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 3d8 Poison Damage damage and Stunned 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 3d10 Poison Damage damage and Paralyzed (1 minute)

offensiveAbilities.name: Pit Trap
offensiveAbilities.description:
The palpares Burrows to create a 30-foot radius sloping pit centered on itself that's 10 feet deep at the center. All creatures in the area must attempt a DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is moved by tremors to a square outside the edge of the pit.

Success As critical success, but the creature is also Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls 10 feet into the pit and is knocked Prone.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Venomous Bite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The palpares has a creature Grabbed

Effect The palpares uses its mandibles to inject venom, dealing 3d8 Acid Damage damage and exposes the creature to palpares venom.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
